active_primary_hypotheses.label: L1_CEILING_DRIVES_SLIGHT_OVER_TARGET_PRIMARY
active_primary_hypotheses.claim: The 66.3333% primary score is slightly above the 65% target mainly because direct rule-resolution L1 questions form a ceiling, rather than because the complete dataset is uniformly too easy.

reject_if: L1 ceases to show a near-ceiling result in the larger frozen sample.
The effect is not present across at least four questions and at least two matched anchors.
The above-target primary is instead explained by broad gains across L2-L5.
confirm_direction_only_if: The L1 ceiling persists under the unchanged R26.18 protocol.
No protocol or conformance artifact explains the difference.

active_primary_hypotheses.permitted_consequence_if_supported: Propose a minimal shadow-only L1 mechanism adjustment for review; do not mutate the canonical candidate automatically.
active_primary_hypotheses.prohibited_consequence: Do not increase difficulty globally or change L2-L5 based on Sentinel5 alone.

secondary_non_trigger_observations.reason_not_primary: Five questions per level are insufficient for a data mutation decision.
